note: A patient crawl of the Malaysian corpus on Open Food Facts, one row per barcode whose published panel survives checking. The energy figure is the one printed on the pack; every row was recomputed as 4·carbs + 4·protein + 9·fat and thrown out at more than 25% from its stated energy, and thrown out again where the macros weighed more than the serving they sat in — a record can be self-consistent and still impossible, which is how 119 g of carbohydrate ends up inside a 140 g noodle pack. Records with no serving size are not here at all: this catalogue prices one serving, and per-100 g with nothing to scale it by is not one. source names the barcode, so any figure can be taken back to the record that supplied it.
